summary: Max Verstappen won the Dutch Grand Prix from pole position, 3.7s ahead of Fernando Alonso, with Pierre Gasly completing the podium.
Pierre Gasly made the biggest climb, from P12 to P3.
George Russell had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag, 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised LAW (10 second time penalty), GAS (5 second time penalty), TSU (5 second time penalty) and PER (5 second time penalty).
There were 101 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 6 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 138 points over Sergio Perez.
